description:
Role Summary 
 We are currently looking for Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) / Automated Driving (AD) algorithm developers to work in our Troy, MI location. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing cutting
 edge technology for ADAS / AD systems.
 This position is part of our Advanced Safety & User Experience.

 Your Role 
 Develop algorithms for ADAS / AD applications e.g. Lane Keeping Assist, Lane Centering, and Assisted Lane Change, Adaptive Cruise Control, etc.
 Test in vehicle, perform data analysis, and debug in rapid-prototyping and/or embedded environment
 Verify the design, assess and optimize the performance in simulated and real-world environments
 Document and report according to established development processes
 
 Your Background 
 Master's degree in electrical / computer / mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Robotics irrelevant field
 Proficiency in developing and implementing algorithms in Simulink/Matlab/Stateflow
 Basic knowledge with vehicle dynamics
 PhD in Electrical / Computer / Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics or relevant field (Nice to have)
 2+ years’ experience in ADAS / AD algorithm design and implementation
 Real-world L2 or higher level automated driving system development•
 Experience with Simulink/Matlab/Stateflow
 Working knowledge of ASPICE, Agile / Autoscrum, ISO26262, SOTIF• Working knowledge of Version Control tools, Work Management tools (e.g. JIRA), Requirement and Configuration Management tools
 
 Your Benefits: 
 Private health care effective day 1 of employment
 Life and accident insurance
 Paid Time Off (Holidays, Vacation and Parental leave)
 Relocation assistance may be available
 Learning and development opportunities
 Discount programs with various manufacturers and retailers
 Recognition for innovation and excellence
 Opportunities to give back to the community
 Tuition Reimbursement
 
 You grow at Aptiv. 
 Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win. 
 You make an impact at Aptiv. 
 One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day.
 You have support at Aptiv. 
 We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package.

 Meet the Next-Generation Aptiv 

 At Aptiv, we deliver innovative solutions that people trust when it matters most. 
 Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on—advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials & Robotics and support life-critical innovation in Medical technologies.
 Guided by our winning culture and values to Think & Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.
   
 Join Us to Deliver Innovative Solutions That People Trust! 
 #LI-MG1
